title: Sort a stream of numbers
summary: Read an unknown amount of ints into a growing heap array, sort, print.
hints: Start with a small capacity and double it with realloc when the array is full.
Assign realloc's result to a temporary pointer first: if it fails you must not lose the old block.
qsort needs a comparison function; do not compute a-b (it can overflow), compare with (a>b)-(a<b).
info: malloc/realloc/free (<stdlib.h>) manage heap memory. realloc(p, n) may move the block; it returns NULL on failure. qsort(base, count, size, cmp) sorts in place.
